Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in the final comparison step. They correctly identified the birth dates (Gus Van Sant: July 24, 1952; Massimo Ceccherini: May 23, 1965) but incorrectly concluded that Van Sant was born "later" (younger) because his birthday (July) is later in the calendar year than Ceccherini's (May). However, the comparison must be done by year first. 1965 is a later year than 1952, meaning Massimo Ceccherini was born later. The Planner failed to prioritize the year over the month/day when determining who was born "later."
